title: SPRINGFIELD SYMPHONY: From the New World
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: From the New World, March 6, 2027
description: The Springfield Symphony Orchestra performs Dvořák's From the New World alongside Adolphus Hailstork's Three Spirituals for Orchestra and Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto, with violinist Fiona Shea, the orchestra's Hellam Competition Winner. Dvořák wrote the symphony after coming to the United States to lead the National Conservatory of Music in New York, where he urged American composers to draw on African American music. It takes place Saturday, March 6, 2027 at 7:30 PM at the Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
